core_obligations: Reduce representability of Delta_X to representability of T1 x_X T2 via the diagonal criterion.
Identify T1' x_U T2' (representable by the algebraic space T'_1 x_U T'_2) as the base change of U -> X along T1 x_X T2 -> X via the displayed 2-fibre square.
Transfer smooth, surjective and representable-by-algebraic-spaces properties along the setoid correspondence and base change.
Conclude F is an algebraic space by the final bootstrap theorem.
proof_roadmap: Diagonal reduction; 2-fibre square base-change identification; property-transfer block; bootstrap finish.
difficulty_reason: The 2-fibre square base-change identification is the substantive step; the rest is a property-transfer chain into bootstrap.
